sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B AutoRound W4A16 on 2x RTX 3090 - GitHub
sources.snippet: Production-oriented Docker deployment for Vishva007/Qwen3.8-27B-W4A16-AutoRound on two 24 GB RTX 3090 GPUs. The repository supports paired 3090s with NVLink and ordinary PCIe-only pairs. It exposes an OpenAI-compatible vLLM API with compiled CUDA graphs, MTP speculative decoding, vision, structured tool calling, and separated reasoning.
